messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: billing-metering token_drift detected for EU1 emitter. Spike in token counts vs ingest. Root metric: delta_tokens=+430k in 15m. Potential customer overage flags firing.

casey: I'm oncall, taking 1st watch. Acknowledge.

maria (billing): seeing corresponding increase in shadow_aggregate. Checking if ratecap backfills triggered overage alerts.

lee (platform): tagging @casey - any service deploys ~10:40pm UTC? I see a config push to emitter-proxy at 10:38 UTC.

casey: rolling logs... pulled sample: ```
2026-02-15T22:38:43Z emitter-proxy INFO emit_count=+12000 route=EU1
2026-02-15T22:39:01Z aggregator WARN window_mismatch id=abcd
```

maria (billing): overage flags: ~12 customers in EU1 got email warnings, not billed yet. We should suppress until reconciliation.

olivia (support): I have one customer pinging CS about overage email. Preparing canned note. Suggest hold outbound emails.

casey: mitigation plan: 1) Pause emitter-proxy retries for EU1 (temporary). 2) Kick recon job to re-aggregate windows at 15m granularity. 3) Suppress billing alerts. Doing step 1 now.

lee (platform): paused retry worker for EU1: `systemctl stop emitter-retry-eu1` :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Action logged: user=lee action=stop_service service=emitter-retry-eu1

maria (billing): suppressing billing-notify for EU1 for 30m window. Notifying finance.

sanjay (eng-sre): running quick query to sanity-check counts: ```
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens) FROM billing.events WHERE region='eu1' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 6;
```
Results show spike at 22:35-22:45.

casey: started recon backfill job: `sh /opt/recon/run_backfill.sh --region eu1 --window 2026-02-15T22:30:00Z/2026-02-15T22:50:00Z` - monitoring.

olivia (support): FYI CS note ready: "We're investigating anomalous overage emails for EU customers; no billing will be charged until reconciliation completes." sending to cs-channel.

maria (billing): finance ack. We'll hold invoicing and track delta. If reconciliation shows <1% net adjustment we'll auto-clear; else manual credit path.

casey: backfill job completed first phase. Preliminary diff shows ~+420k tokens attributed to emitter retry loop. Looks like duplicate emit path.

lee (platform): root cause: retry dedupe key absent after proxy upgrade. Reverting patch to 10:36 image to restore dedupe headers.

incidents-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by lee.

casey: after rollback, stream metrics returning to baseline. I'll keep an eye for 15m.

maria (billing): unsuppressing alerts after confirmation? Wait 10m after baseline stable, then reconcile and clear flags.

olivia (support): sent update to affected customers, marking \"investigating, no charges expected\".

sanjay (eng-sre): post-mitigation check: delta_tokens in subsequent 15m window down to +2k. Looks resolved.

casey: closing pager, will open postmortem and include timeline + customer impact section. Assigning to lee+billing for RCA and credit plan.

lee (platform): will draft RCA PR and rollback notes.

maria (billing): will prepare list of affected accounts and proposed credits. Expect preliminary list in 2 hours.

incidents-bot: Pager resolved by casey at 2026-02-15T23:10:00Z :white_check_mark:

casey: thanks all. If anyone sees residual noise ping me.
